revised_answer: The observations provisionally support that treating a narrow implementation boundary as the product identity contributes to mission drift: coherent green checks can omit the complete outcome when they protect only registered policy-admission scope. Whether additional controls should admit unregistered mission intent without speculative universal infrastructure remains unresolved.
